Punchline: Bridges live FFXIV crafting state to a web solver over a local WebSocket.
Description: Reads the active craft condition, step, your stats, and the recipe's constraints each framework tick, broadcasts them over a local WebSocket (127.0.0.1:8014) to a paired userscript, and renders the solver's suggested next action as a borderless overlay anchored to the Synthesis window.
Author: wirumn
Name: CraftCast
